prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for original retro-futuristic transport montage. Instruments: analog arpeggios, rounded bass, tight gated snare. 126 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a clipped falling fifth answered by two repeated notes. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A high-energy, driving electronic track featuring a prominent synth melody, pulsing bass, and a steady beat, building with layers of synth pads and arpeggios.
description.zh: 一首高能量、富有动感的电子音乐，带有突出的合成器旋律、脉动的低音和稳定的节拍，通过合成器衬底和琶音层层递进。
